thread:
Jess: VertexApps reporting intermittent 429s + p95 spikes (~2.1-3.0s) on dedicated pool eu-w-13 since ~09:12 UTC. Customer says spikes line up with other tenants' big bursts.
Omar: can you share the pool id and an example log?
Jess: pool: eu-w-13. log snippet: 
``
2026-03-02T09:14:07Z req=vk-7 p95=2.95s status=429 backend=eu-w-13
host=gw-eu-w-13 gpu_slice=3 sm_util=99% mem_used=68%
```
Nina: sm_util 99% on slice3 — smells like a noisy neighbor saturating SMs. whats the MIG layout on that host?
Jess: layout: [1g.5gb, 1g.5gb, 2g.10gb, 4g.20gb]. Vertex is on slice0 (1g), internal-batch on slice3 (4g).
Ryan: any autoscale events around the window?
InfraBot: autoscale: pool eu-w-13 added +1 slot at 09:15 UTC (trigger: queue-depth).
Omar: autoscale can hide the root cause. if a sibling saturates SMs for bursts, small-slice tenants still get p95 blips and 429s.
Nina: pulling NVML/perf for 09:10-09:20 now. please also grab per-slice L2/L3 miss stats and kernel names.
Jess: fetched traces: slice3 had sustained matmul kernels 'batched_gemm_v2' with high concurrency; slice0 shows enqueue stalls and retry backoffs around 09:14. memory bw on slice3 peaked and stayed high ~6-8s.
Ryan: co-resident tenants: vertex (slice0), batch-internal (slice3), qa (slice1), analytics (slice2). batch-internal job ib-3312 had a surge at 09:14.
Nina: propose repro plan: 1) request 15-20min maintenance window from VertexApps; 2) migrate Vertex to warm spare OR run synthetic workload in staging with identical MIG layout; 3) run SM-saturating kernel on slice3 while blasting small qps at slice0 to confirm p95/429 correlation.
Jess: Vertex agreed to a 10:05-10:25 UTC slot. I'm scheduling migration at 10:03 as fallback.
InfraBot: action logged: SUPPORT-7234 created, priority=P2. assignees: Nina, Ryan, infra-ops.
Omar: short-term mitigations before eviction: - throttle batch-internal with cgroup tokens or driver-level QOS if available; - apply short autoscale cooldown to avoid rapid slot churn; - consider temporary per-slice concurrency cap in runtime.
Nina: note: PCIe topology could amplify cross-slice DMA pressure. slice3 is across PCIe root 1 while slice0 is on root 0; capture pcie_bw and DMA latencies during repro.
Ryan: also check runtime-level amplification: prefix/KV cache lockstep can cause bursts of small ops that coincide poorly with sibling kernels. consider isolating hot prefixes.
Jess: plan to move Vertex to spare host at 10:03; will run perf capture (nvprof/perf) on original host during the approved window and run the synthetic in staging at 10:12.
Nina: post-repro checklist: compare p95/p99 + 429 rate pre/post, validate L2/L3 eviction patterns, and check if autoscale suppressed symptoms but not root cause.
Omar: if SM-level saturation reproduces, escalate to eng-runtime for kernel-level QOS or cgroup-based GPU scheduling options. possible mitigations: kernel cgroup shaping, per-slice SM concurrency cap, or eviction policy for heavy-batch tenants.
Jess: updating customer now. will paste perf logs and results after the run. thanks all :thumbsup:
